notes.subject: אנוש מן הארץ
notes.rationale: 'Man bilong graun' (man i save dai) — ol tanim tok i stap klostu: KJV 'man of the earth' o 'man bilong graun i no ken opresim'

notes.subject: ⟨ol⟩
notes.rationale: Hibru i no tok olsem Ol man; pronaun bilong Tok Pisin

notes.subject: יוסיף עוד
notes.rationale: Wanpela tok 'mekim moa' i gat tupela tok Hibru i tok wanem senis — Yosef yet i min 'mekim moa'

translation: Bilong kotim ol pikinini man i no gat papa bilong en na ol man ol i bagarapim, bilong man bilong graun i no ken mekim moa pasin bilong skerim ⟨ol⟩.

tokens.gloss: ol pikinini man i no gat papa bilong en
na ol man ol i bagarapim
